All operations are confined to standard packaging tasks—cloning the repo, running the upstream installer, and placing files in appropriate system directories under `$pkgdir`. The package does not modify system state outside of the package root, nor does it install scripts that run outside of the build/install process.

While the use of an executable script (`install.sh`) from the upstream introduces a degree of trust in the upstream developer, this is normal for theme packages and not inherently malicious. The package follows standard AUR packaging conventions and poses no evident supply-chain risk.
